```{webr-r}
#| context: interactive

overall_grade <- function() {
  weights <- c(final = 0.25, 
               quizzes = 0.15, 
               midterm1 = 0.15, 
               homework = 0.15, 
               github = 0.025, 
               lab = 0.025, 
               attendance = 0.05, 
               progstatexp = 0.05, 
               proficiencytest = 0.15)
  scores <- c(final = 100, 
             quizzes = 100, 
             midterm1 = 100, 
             homework = 100, 
             github = 100, 
             lab = 100, 
             attendance = 100, 
             progstatexp = 100, 
             proficiencytest = 100)
  sum(scores[names(weights)]*weights)
}

overall_grade()
```
